description: This script manages U-Boot environment configurations using UCI commands and configuration files. It provides functions to add UCI configurations for U-Boot environment variables and system-specific settings, as well as app-specific configurations that modify configuration files based on device attributes.

methods.name: _ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Adds a U-Boot environment configuration to UCI, setting device, offset, env size, security size, and number of sections.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Wrapper function to add ubootenv configuration using specific configuration type.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_uci_sys_config
methods.description: Wrapper function to add ubootsys configuration using specific configuration type.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_app_config
methods.description: Adds application-specific configuration to a file based on device attributes, with checks for existing entries.
